prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS2 mean temperature 41.9 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS3 mean temperature 39.2 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.89 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.46 s (within 2% of healthy). Minor delay in pressure rise and slight inter-sensor switching lag indicate beginning valve actuation lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.42 l/min (2% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 398 W·min/l (4% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.9 % (5% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
